scripts.build: pnpm run verify:harness && pnpm run build:host && pnpm --filter @dsh-companion/web build
scripts.build:native: pnpm run verify:harness && pnpm run build:host && pnpm --filter @dsh-companion/web build:native
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run verify:harness && pnpm run build:host && pnpm --filter @dsh-companion/web dev --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.host: pnpm run build && pnpm run host:plugin:install && node scripts/start-harness.mjs
scripts.test:web: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run verify:harness && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @dsh-companion/host... typecheck
